name: ViaBridge
description: Lets a Minecraft 1.21.4 client join newer servers (1.21.11 and friends) with nothing installed server-side.
//: The bundled ViaVersion and ViaBackwards jars both declare a dependency on a mod called 'viafabric', and ViaBackwards registers its protocols through the 'viafabric:via_api_initialized' entrypoint. Providing that id is what lets those jars load and initialise inside this mod.
